## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes godotengine/godot-proposals#5615

## Additional information

<!--
Provide additional information and explanation of your PR, including areas that you are uncertain of or require special attention from reviewers. For examples, please read our pull request guidelines: https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/pull_requests/pull_request_guidelines.html#explain-your-contributions
-->
From what I've seen, it is recommended to use the RandomNumberGenerator object. However, according to godotengine/godot-proposals#5615, it doesn't allow some functions such as ``Array.shuffle()`` (this is a 3 year old PR, things may have changed, but from my searching I couldn't find any easy alternative).

Basically, I fell down the generic coder thing of _I could spend 5 minutes implementing a basic custom random number generator global system ORRR spend way longer making a change to THE ENTIRE GAME ENGINE_ :upside_down_face: 

Tested on Fedora KDE

Finally, AI note: This is such a basic system that yeah, of course I didn't use AI to code this! However, I barely know C++ so I asked ChatGPT basic questions such as if I needed to add things to header files, if I am using the right data types, etc. Additionally, I asked if I was missing anything (for example, while I wrote the docs, I only did so because it told me I should). TL;DR: I have social anxiety so I just wanted it to proofread/check everything before I created this PR.
